Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Strict accountability and early, immediate retribution; severity and rigidity. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.body: A disagreement about limits can become a fight over authority when every challenge to a rule brings a harsher consequence. When Saturn squares Pluto, structure and concentrated power create friction, making money, access, procedure, or punishment more useful as leverage. Escalation can bury the original issue underneath a contest over who gets to decide without being questioned. A system that cannot tolerate review reveals something important about where the power actually sits.
